t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Start by picking red/pink/purple/brown gnomes (these produce red baskets). Keep picking them until the red baskets start producing 0 mushrooms. Then switch to the other colours of gnomes. Switch back when they start producing 0 mushrooms, then repeat this cycle as needed.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes divide into 2 categories:red-based colours (RED / PINK / PURPLE / BROWN)yellow/blue-based colours (YELLOW / GREEN / BLUE / ORANGE)Use your time now to memorise one of these sets of colours. In the forest you see either a red or yellow basket in case you forget which colours go in which category.Pick a category and stick with it while it is producing lots of mushrooms (the highest value I saw was 9 mushrooms, if you're consistently getting 4+ then stick with it and don't worry about changing). When it starts producing fewer mushrooms (0-2ish), try swapping over to the other set of colours.
